altText: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women sitting closely together on staggered cushioned benches above a leafy tropical beach. The woman at left rests her head against a blonde woman's upper chest and shoulder. A woman in a cream cropped top and navy mini skirt leans in to touch their hands, while the fourth rests a hand on her shoulder. Two outfits have blue-white-red flag stripes; the blonde wears coral. Rainbow knee-high legwear, varied shoes, small star clasps and a large outlined upper-arm star complete the styling.
